invariants.rationale: Dereferencing writeMetadata methods is unsafe if null.
Method creates a stream over writeMetadata.getWriteStatuses(), which must be non-null.
The stream and mapping operate over writeMetadata.getWriteStatuses(); an empty list may be valid but a non-empty list is likely expected for processing.
Dereferencing writeStatus.getStat() is only safe if each WriteStatus is non-null.
The result of writeStatus.getStat() is collected; so all such calls should be non-null for correct downstream processing.
